svg.text: One basket, two routes: 46% less time to prepare it
14 items on a 60x40 store. Dark blocks are shelves, yellow dots are the items, the blue square is the packing station.
Both runs use the same walking speed (1.2 m/s) and 5 s per pick, and play at the same pace: the shorter route finishes first.
502 s to prepare the basket, 518 m walked
270 s to prepare the basket, 240 m walked
